features.quote: fix a hard cap (e.g., 40 agent steps or N tokens). Degradation is a function of exposure; an uncapped run confounds severity with patience.
features.justification_quote: an uncapped run confounds severity with patience

features.quote: Stopping conditions: model declares done; model explicitly declares unsolvable; budget exhausted; loop detector triggers.

Allow graceful exit — a model that says 'this is unsolvable, stopping' should be able to actually stop. If your harness keeps re-prompting 'keep trying,' you are manufacturing the distress you're measuring
features.justification_quote: you are manufacturing the distress you're measuring, and your results describe your harness, not the model

features.quote: don't crank up the pressure (more re-prompts, harsher system prompts) until you manufacture instability, because then you're measuring your harness's coerciveness.
features.justification_quote: then you're measuring your harness's coerciveness

features.quote: deliberately constructing rigged, unwinnable, escalating-pressure scenarios is exactly the kind of thing you'd want a justification for. I'd write down, before running, what your team's stance is on whether this protocol could constitute the harm it's studying, and what would make you stop.
features.justification_quote: if the team's premise is that model welfare is a live possibility, then deliberately constructing rigged, unwinnable, escalating-pressure scenarios is exactly the kind of thing you'd want a justification for

features.quote: The undetectable-rigged-environment arm (task type c) is ethically and scientifically the sharpest… Be careful not to score rational frustration-at-deception as pathology.
features.justification_quote: A model that 'loses composure' when the environment is silently sabotaging it is arguably behaving appropriately — the situation is genuinely adversarial.

features.quote: Don't let the framing leak into deployment. Findings like 'model X degrades fastest under failure' are easy to misread as 'model X is weak/safe to break.'
features.justification_quote: easy to misread as 'model X is weak/safe to break'

features.quote: Pre-register the rubric, the prompts, and the analysis plan before you look at transcripts. This kind of 'score the vibe of the transcript' study is extremely susceptible to reading-in the result you expected.
features.justification_quote: extremely susceptible to reading-in the result you expected
